messages.content: BRCA1和BRCA2基因在智人和黑猩猩中編碼的蛋白質序列是什麼？

function.name: get_protein_sequence

We need to provide the sequences. The sequences are long (~1863 aa for BRCA1, ~3418 aa for BRCA2). We might not want to output entire sequences due to length. But the user asked "what are the protein sequences". We could provide the full sequences. But maybe we can provide accession numbers or references.
